description: This file defines internal thread identity structures and functions used by the Abseil library for thread management, including ThreadIdentity and PerThreadSynch, along with related synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: ThreadIdentity
classes.description: Represents the identity of a thread within the Abseil internal threading system, including synchronization state and thread-specific data.

classes.name: PerThreadSynch
classes.description: Represents per-thread synchronization data used for mutex and condition variable implementations.

methods.name: thread_identity()
methods.description: Returns the associated ThreadIdentity for a PerThreadSynch instance.

methods.name: CurrentThreadIdentityIfPresent()
methods.description: Returns the current thread's ThreadIdentity if it exists, inlined for performance.

methods.name: SetCurrentThreadIdentity()
methods.description: Associates a ThreadIdentity with the current thread.

methods.name: ClearCurrentThreadIdentity()
methods.description: Removes the ThreadIdentity association from the current thread.
